This '''species''' had [[Color/Legends| light pink]] skin. At least two juvenile members of this [[Species/Legends|species]], including [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]] [[Farn Klin]], were present in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the galactic [[planet|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] for a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] transmission from [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />
